info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Party Reference Data Validation API
info.description: The Party Reference Data Validation API allows for the validation of party reference data within the customer management framework. This endpoint supports the comprehensive assessment and update of reference records to ensure data integrity and compliance. Typical consumers include financial institutions and data management systems that rely on accurate customer information for regulatory reporting and operational efficiency. By validating party reference data, organizations can minimize errors and enhance the reliability of their customer interactions.

put.summary: Update validations for a specific party reference.
put.description: This operation allows users to update the validation data for a specific party reference identified by PARTY-600045 in the customer management system. Ensure all required fields are correctly populated before submitting the request.
